name: Declarative Form Ajax Demo
description: Test / Demo module for Declarative Ajax Forms.
project_description: Demo/test submodule of Declarative Form AJAX. It registers two example routes, /demo/declarative-ajax-form and /demo/declarative-ajax-element-form, each rendering a FormBase that shows the declarative 'updated_by' AJAX syntax in action: containers, details, textfields and checkboxes that re-render when a controlling element changes. The second form uses a custom render element (declarative_form_ajax_demo_select, class TestSelect) that ships its own built-in AJAX callback, demonstrating that Declarative Form AJAX chains a pre-existing callback. Intended purely as reference/example code; not for production sites.
